SoulTalk: Entertaining and a Landscape of Creativity!. To the developers of SoulTalk,

SoulTalk caught my eye when I was looking for a replacement to PolyBuzz after they started heavily censoring mature content. I feel that an AI chatbot is best when the user has as much freedom on their end as possible to make their own unique interactions and stories with the chatbot. When content is censored, this can ultimately be restricted. Thankfully, SoulTalk is completely uncensored and allows for the user to unleash their creativity uninterrupted. There also isn’t a chat limit or time limit, further reinforcing uninterrupted creativity. There is also a reasonable chat to ad ratio for free users. With all of that, I would give SoulTalk a 5/5.

However, SoulTalk isn’t necessarily a 5/5 for me until one thing is added. Multi-character chatting! Multi-character chatting allows for even more personality, interaction, and storylines with the chatbots and users. This feature could also be helpful for users that may want to talk to a cast of characters from a show all together in one “group chat” instead of using individual characters. Considering this, my final rating for SoulTalk is a 4.5. This does round to five stars, but SoulTalk isn’t perfect. Therefore, 4 star rating on the App Store, 4.5 star rating personally.
